# Vendored Vanna distribution

- Package: `vanna==2.0.2` (MIT)
- Source: <https://pypi.org/project/vanna/2.0.2/>
- Wheel: `wheels/vanna-2.0.2-py3-none-any.whl`
- SHA-256: `d54f039572b0bcc520859ba99b7a587bdf96eebafc0c77c28fe44c0962550553`
- The Docker build uses this directory as a `--find-links` source while the
  hash-locked requirements file pins Vanna and its complete dependency closure.
- The upstream GitHub repository is archived; this pin is a PoC compatibility
  baseline and must be re-evaluated before production adoption.

The wheel's distribution metadata declares the MIT license. The upstream
license file is shipped inside the wheel at `vanna-2.0.2.dist-info/licenses/`.
